parameters.content:
## ENTIN live call tools
ElevenLabs calls one of the **13 webhooks on the left** during the call, one per tool, e.g. `/webhook/entin/verify_caller`.

1. Load the call's session from the **Sessions** tab
2. **Which Step?** blocks secrets (PIN/OTP/CVV/password/card no.) and checks the caller is verified enough
3. Each tool reads/writes the Google Sheet
4. **Build Reply** answers ElevenLabs, then the session, call log, security cases and handoffs are saved
